prompts.template: Analyze only the supplied workspace scope and identify constraints, exclusions, and ambiguities. Do not propose target-facing actions. Objective: {{objective}}
Analyze the supplied evidence for provenance, consistency, and security-relevant observations. Do not invent evidence or perform target-facing actions. Objective: {{objective}}
Assess risk from the supplied observations and evidence only. Identify uncertainty and require human review when confidence is insufficient. Objective: {{objective}}
Synthesize supplied, traceable observations into a concise report draft. Preserve uncertainty and evidence references; never fabricate findings. Objective: {{objective}}
